source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8 with Fig. 9.18 (PDF 206-207).

blocks.text: Charged zarre ka rasta ilaqe ki electric field se tay hota hai. Agar field yaksan ho aur charged zarra field ke saath chal raha ho to rasta aam taur par seedha hota hai. Magar agar charged zarra mukhalif charged mutawazi plates ke darmiyan yaksan field mein amudi taur par kisi velocity se dakhil ho (Fig. 9.18) to seedha nahi jayega. Us ka rasta parabola hoga, bilkul gravitational field mein ufuqi phenke gaye projectile ki tarah: charged zarre ki velocity ka ufuqi juz mustaqil rehta hai, jabke amudi juz electric force se tez hota hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse, oopar + aur neeche - plate, magenta lines neeche. (a) Musbat zarra baen se dakhil, dotted rasta neeche (-) plate tak murta hai. (b) Manfi zarra baen se dakhil, dotted rasta oopar (+) plate tak murta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.18 (kitab ki Figure 9.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ufuqi velocity nahi badalti, magar field ki force amudi raftar barhati hai; is liye rasta projectile jaisa parabola hai. Musbat zarra manfi plate aur manfi zarra musbat plate ki taraf murta hai.

Figure 9.18 dikhati hai ke musbat charged zarra manfi charged plate ki taraf khincha jata hai aur usi simt mein mur jata (deflect hota) hai. Doosri taraf manfi charged zarra musbat charged plate ki taraf khincha jata aur usi simt mein murta hai.

blocks.caption: Charged zarra aur projectile
rows: qE, mustaqil, plates ke aar paar

blocks.prompt: Ek musbat aur ek manfi zarra ufuqi plates (oopar musbat plate) ke darmiyan field mein ufuqi chalte hue dakhil hote hain. Un ke raston ka bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Har ek apni ufuqi velocity rakhta hai jabke electric force us ki amudi velocity yaksan badalti hai, to har ek parabola par chalta hai. Musbat zarra neeche manfi plate ki taraf murta hai; manfi zarra oopar musbat plate ki taraf. Field lines ke saath chalta zarra seedhi lakeer mein jata hai, tez ya dheema hota hua.

items: Yaksan field ke saath chalna: seedha rasta. Field ke aar paar dakhil hona: ufuqi projectile jaisa parabola, ufuqi velocity mustaqil, amudi velocity tez; musbat charges manfi plate ki taraf, manfi charges musbat plate ki taraf murte hain.
